if not deferred_save_available(id): return
	if not can_checkpoint_bank(player): return
	var fields:=action.split("_")
	if fields.size()!=3 or not fields[2].is_valid_int(): return
	var index:=int(fields[2])
	var return_before: Dictionary=progress.garden_interactions.duplicate(true)
	var reserve:=seed_reserve(player)
	var old_pouch: bool=player.pouch
	var seed: int=-1
	if fields[1]=="seed":
		if index<0 or index>=player.carried_seeds.size(): return
		seed=int(player.carried_seeds[index])
		player.carried_seeds.remove_at(index)
		preload("res://garden_return_service.gd").bank(self,player,[seed],"checkpoint:"+str(encounter_number))
		reserve.unknown.append(seed)
		if index==0 and player.get("safe_items",[]).is_empty(): player.pouch=false
	elif fields[1]=="part":
		if index<=0 or index>=Parts.DEFINITIONS.size() or player.carried_parts[index]<=0: return
		player.carried_parts[index]-=1
		reserve.parts[index]+=1
	else: return
	if progress.save_garden()!=OK:
		progress.garden_interactions=return_before
		if seed>=0:
			reserve.unknown.pop_back()
			player.carried_seeds.insert(index,seed)
			player.pouch=old_pouch
		else:
			player.carried_parts[index]+=1
			reserve.parts[index]-=1
		tell(id,"Could not save courier delivery. Your item was returned.")
		return
	player.last_deposit=encounter_number
	tell(id,"Item sent to Garden storage.")

				player.front_guard_until=now+int(skill.duration)+duration;player.guard_face=player.facing.normalized()

			player.focus_until=now+int(skill.duration)+duration
			effect_point=player.pos
		"charge","harvest":
			var facing: Vector3=(point-player.pos).normalized() if target!=-2 else player.facing
			var distance:=float(skill.travel)
			if target!=-2: distance=minf(distance,maxf(0,player.pos.distance_to(point)-.6))
			player.pos=plan.center if aimed else battlefield.dash(player.pos,player.pos+facing*distance)

		"quake","nova","bloodmoon":

				effect_point=plan.center if aimed else preload("res://warden_combat.gd").quake_center(self,player,battlefield,skill,now)
				skill.effect_origin=effect_point
			targets=skill_area_targets(effect_point,radius,effect_point)
		"judgement":
			effect_point=point
			targets=skill_area_targets(point,radius,player.pos)
		"salvo":
			var aim: Vector3=point-player.pos

			if player.facing.length_squared()<.001: player.facing=Vector3.FORWARD
			targets=skill_line_targets(player.pos,player.facing,range_limit,float(skill.width),int(skill.targets))
			effect_point=point
		"siphon":

	combat_events_api.class_complete(self,event,adapter,cast_origin,effect_point,targets,recipients,now,radius)

			bonus_heal=0
	targets=Traits.spread_targets(self,player,targets,skill,stats)

func update_health_pool() -> void:
	var fill := Orb.fractions(health_orb.hp, health_orb.maximum, health_orb.lost)
	var previous := Orb.fractions(health_orb.from_hp, health_orb.maximum, health_orb.lost)
	var flash := 1.0 - clampf(float(Time.get_ticks_msec() - health_orb.changed_at) / Orb.CHANGE_MS, 0.0, 1.0)
	pool_material.set_shader_parameter("health", fill.x)
	pool_material.set_shader_parameter("capacity", fill.y)
	pool_material.set_shader_parameter("previous", previous.x)
	pool_material.set_shader_parameter("flash", flash)
	var vitals := "%d / %d HP" % [int(health_orb.hp), health_orb.maximum]
	if pool_vitals.text != vitals:
		pool_vitals.text = vitals
	var sealed := "−%d max HP" % health_orb.lost if health_orb.lost > 0 else ""
	if pool_capacity.text != sealed:
		pool_capacity.text = sealed
	if not health_pool.visible:
		health_pool.show()
	layout_health_pool()

func layout_health_pool() -> void:
	var active := bool(state.get("wild", false))
	var chart := Exploration.chart_bounds(size, chart_expanded)
	var diameter := minf(166.0, size.x * 0.16)
	var right := chart.position.x - 8.0 if active else size.x - 16.0
	var bottom := size.y - 12.0
	var action_end := 672.0 if not state.get("core", {}).is_empty() else 572.0
	if active and (chart_expanded or right - diameter < action_end + 8.0):
		# Move above the map when the horizontal gap is too narrow.
		right = Exploration.chart_bounds(size, false).position.x - 8.0
		bottom = chart.position.y - 8.0
	health_pool.position = Vector2(right - diameter, bottom - diameter)
	health_pool.size = Vector2.ONE * diameter
	pool_vitals.position = Vector2(0, diameter * 0.55)
	pool_vitals.size.x = diameter
	pool_capacity.position = Vector2(0, diameter * 0.69)
	pool_capacity.size.x = diameter

 var garden=load("res://garden_interaction_service.gd")
 if not garden.eligible(game,id):return false
 var player: Dictionary=game.players[id]
 if not game.travel_kind.is_empty() or garden.nearest(game,player,garden.projection(game,id))!="spring_water":
  game.tell(id,"Visit the sheltered spring to fill your watering vessel.")
  return false
 if player.get("spring_water",false):return true
 player.spring_water=true
 game.tell(id,"Watering vessel filled. Use it on a growing crop.")
 preload("res://diagnostic_journal.gd").event("garden","spring_water_collected",{"actor":id,"point":"spring_water"})
 return true
